thesis: KDP is a trend-4 uptrend (close 36.63 above SMA20 34.93, SMA50 32.78 and SMA200 29.87) with strong relative strength (rs_63 0.35) in a leading defensive group (XLP) during a risk-off tape, and the 2026-11-03 earnings event has passed. The edge is modest: it needs a pullback entry and a breakout through the 37.89 52-week high to reach 39.49, so it rates Overweight on a conditional entry, not Buy. Stop 34.0 and target 39.49 are kept from the technical card; the entry is set at the zone midpoint 36.1 and the zone's upper bound is cut from 36.63 to 36.1, because at 36.63 reward/risk is only 1.09, while at 36.1 it is 1.61.
invalidation: Daily close below 34.0 (under the 10-day swing low 34.28), or a close back below SMA20 (about 34.93) after a failed attempt at 37.89.
